contract: docs/branded-emails.md: 600px fluid email shell, Precision logo, brand palette, 24/32px title, 14/22px body, preserved token links and disabled optional notices.

accessibility.evidence: Semantic h1, presentation tables, logo alt text, keyboard-focused primary link and 50px action target verified in Chromium. Body contrast 9.18:1, primary action 9.73:1, supporting text at least 5.18:1. Essential content survives image blocking. Native mail-client/assistive-technology certification is not claimed.

responsive.evidence: All 12 unique templates rendered at every target width without horizontal overflow. Long security headings and an eight-digit code remain readable at 320px. Images-blocked/CSS-stripped fallback inspected at 320px.

loading.reason: Messages are fully rendered by Auth before delivery; there is no asynchronous email UI.

empty.reason: Transactional templates always contain an event description and security guidance; no empty dataset is rendered.

error.reason: Invalid or expired token errors render in the application, not the email. Existing recovery/browser regressions cover those destinations.

partial.evidence: Blocked-image preview retains ZeeSpare alt text, live heading, action and password-safety guidance even with media queries removed.

success.evidence: Action-required, verification-code and completed-change notices are rendered in the retained screenshots. Local Auth delivery verified new code and email-change templates.

permission.reason: Email branding introduces no permissions or new sending endpoints. Auth and existing invitation guards continue to determine delivery and token acceptance.

renderedEvidence.observation: Centered 600px card; compact sign-in title, Precision logo, lime action and mint security panel.
Invitation uses the same shell and retains one-hour link/seven-day invitation guidance.
Password-change notification has clear incident guidance without an unnecessary action button.
Readable one-line heading, full-width action and security guidance; no horizontal scrolling.
Full-page capture at 320x568: eight-digit fixture fits and the footer wraps naturally below the viewport.
Full-page capture with logo blocked, media queries removed and dark browser preference; all action/security text remains readable.
